title: On a Turán's theorem for arithmetic progressions
summary: Let $m\geq 1$ be a fixed integer, $a$ an integer satisfying $(a,m)=1$, and $z\geq 1$ a real parameter. Denote by $ω_{z}(n;m,a)$ the number of distinct prime divisors $p$ of $n$ satisfying $p\equiv a\, (m)$ and $p\leq z$. We study an asymptotic behaviour of $\sum_{n\leq x}\left(ω_{z}(n;m,a)-\frac{1}{\varphi(m)}\log\log z\right)^{k}$ as $x\to\infty$ for a wide range of positive integer $k\geq 2$, where $\varphi(\cdot)$ is the Euler function.
